The views and opinions of authors expressed herein do not necessarily state or reflect those of the United States Government or any agency thereof. ii EXECUTIVE SUMMARY This report establishes the process design basis for the front-end engineering design (FEED) of a carbon capture and injection facility at One Earth Energy's (OEE) ethanol production plant in Gibson City, Illinois, developed as part of the Illinois Storage Corridor CarbonSAFE Phase III project. The facility is designed to compress and dehydrate up to approximately 458,000 metric tonnes of CO 2 per year, sourced directly from OEE's ethanol fermenters, for permanent injection into a saline aquifer approximately four miles from the plant. At normal operating conditions, the system will process 1,290 metric tonnes of CO per day, assuming 355 operating days per year and an ethanol production 2 rate of 160 million gallons per year.
